branches.name: AI & Machine Learning
branches.description: Build intelligent systems that learn, reason, and adapt. From deep learning to generative AI.

fitReasons.high_ABS: Requires strong abstract mathematical thinking for model architecture.
fitReasons.high_MTH: Core calculus, probability, and linear algebra are foundational.
fitReasons.high_BLD: You'll build and ship production ML pipelines.

branches.name: Computer Science & Engineering
branches.description: The bedrock of tech — algorithms, systems, OS, networks, and software engineering at scale.

fitReasons.high_SYS: Systems thinking is the heart of CS.
fitReasons.high_ABS: Abstract problem solving defines top CS engineers.
fitReasons.high_STM: CS depth requires sustained academic commitment.

branches.name: Electronics & Communication Engg.
branches.description: Bridging hardware and software — from microcontrollers to 5G networks and embedded systems.

fitReasons.high_HW: Hands-on hardware design is central to ECE.
fitReasons.high_SYS: Systems thinking applies to circuit and network design.
fitReasons.high_MTH: Signal processing relies heavily on Fourier and complex analysis.

branches.name: Data Science & Analytics
branches.description: Translate raw data into business decisions using statistical modeling, visualization, and ML.

fitReasons.high_MTH: Statistical foundations power all data science work.
fitReasons.high_ABS: Pattern recognition from abstract data is the core skill.
fitReasons.high_FIN: Data science offers stable roles at banks and consultancies.

branches.name: Cybersecurity
branches.description: Defend systems from adversaries. Ethical hacking, cryptography, threat intelligence, and digital forensics.

fitReasons.high_RSK: Security work involves calculated risk and adversarial thinking.
fitReasons.high_SYS: You need to understand entire system architectures to break or defend them.
fitReasons.high_AMB: Threats evolve constantly — adaptability is a survival skill.

branches.name: Robotics & Automation
branches.description: Design autonomous machines — from industrial arms to space rovers. Mechatronics meets AI.

fitReasons.high_HW: Physical systems design is at the core of robotics.
fitReasons.high_BLD: You ship real, tangible products that move and act.
fitReasons.high_SYS: Integrating hardware, software, and sensors demands systems thinking.

branches.name: Mechanical Engineering
branches.description: Design, analyze, and manufacture mechanical systems — from automotive to aerospace and energy.

fitReasons.high_HW: Physical design and fabrication are the foundation.
fitReasons.high_STM: Core subjects require sustained academic rigor.
fitReasons.high_SYS: Systems integration from component to machine level.

branches.name: Civil Engineering
branches.description: Build the infrastructure of civilization — bridges, dams, smart cities, and structural systems.

fitReasons.high_SYS: Large-scale civil projects demand rigorous systems planning.
fitReasons.high_FIN: Govt. sector roles offer security and stable income.

branches.name: Chemical Engineering
branches.description: Scale chemistry from lab to industry — oil refineries, pharmaceuticals, polymers, and green energy.

fitReasons.high_MTH: Chemical process equations demand strong mathematical modeling.
fitReasons.high_SYS: Industrial process design is a system-of-systems challenge.

branches.name: Biotechnology & Bioinformatics
branches.description: Merge biology with engineering — gene editing, drug discovery, bioinformatics pipelines, and synthetic biology.

fitReasons.high_ABS: Computational biology requires modeling complex biological systems.
fitReasons.high_MTH: Bioinformatics relies on statistical genomics and algorithms.
fitReasons.high_CRE: Designing novel therapeutics blends creativity with rigor.

branches.name: Electrical & Electronics Engg.
branches.description: Power systems, electric vehicles, smart grids, and control systems — the energy backbone of the future.

fitReasons.high_HW: Electrical systems are physical — you'll work with real power infrastructure.
fitReasons.high_MTH: Circuit theory, Fourier transforms, and control theory are heavy math.
fitReasons.high_SYS: Power grids and EV systems demand end-to-end systems thinking.

branches.name: Aerospace Engineering
branches.description: Design aircraft, spacecraft, and propulsion systems. ISRO, DRDO, and the private space race await.

fitReasons.high_MTH: Aerodynamics, orbital mechanics, and propulsion are deeply mathematical.
fitReasons.high_RSK: The field involves high-stakes, calculated engineering decisions.
